Korthia, City of Secrets is an ancient realm of the Shadowlands that was long lost in the In-Between before being dragged into the Maw by the chains of the Jailer. Similar to Oribos, Korthia is inhabited by attendants but also its own strange creatures, and the area contains many mysteries and secrets of the First Ones. The Jailer is searching for these secrets in the hopes of finding the key to fulfill his twisted vision for the Shadowlands. Korthia was hidden away in the In-Between to hide things that the races of the Shadowlands didn't want people like the Jailer to find.
Korthia was controlled by the Fatescribe Roh-Kalo and an Archivist who kept track of the records. The Archivist, currently Archivist Roh-Suir, wields a Lodestaff capable of locating any artifact, usually powered by the Netherstar. Korthia being stolen by the Jailer has torn the very fabric of the Shadowlands. Before the Primus was taken by the Jailer, he had entrusted his sigil to Korthia.

Similar to [[Oribos]], Korthia is inhabited by [[attendant]]s but also its own strange creatures, and the area contains many mysteries and secrets of the [[First Ones]]. The Jailer is searching for these secrets in the hopes of finding the key to fulfill his twisted vision for the Shadowlands.{{Ref web|url=https://worldofwarcraft.com/en-us/news/23624699/|title=Shape the Fate of the Shadowlands in Chains of Domination|author={{Blizz|Blizzard Entertainment}}|date=2021-02-20|accessdate=2021-03-24}}{{Ref web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=94xTxh8p44E&t=12m|title=BlizzConline 2021 - World of Warcraft: Shadowlands Update|author=World of Warcraft|publisher=YouTube|date=2021-02-20}} Korthia was hidden away in the In-Between to hide things that the races of the Shadowlands didn't want people like the Jailer to find.[https://www.gamereactor.eu/video/561313/WoW+Shadowlands+Chains+of+Domination+Interview/ Johnny Cash and Frank Kowalkowski with Gamereactor] - Chains of Domination. Johnny Cash: "And it was hidden away because it has a lot of things they didn't want people like the Jailer to find" Korthia was controlled by the [[Fatescribe Roh-Kalo]] and an Archivist who kept track of the records. The Archivist, currently [[Archivist Roh-Suir]], wields a [[:Lodestaff]] capable of locating any artifact, usually powered by [[:the Netherstar]].[[The Sundered Staff]][[An Infusion of Anima]][[Consulting the Experts]] Korthia being stolen by the Jailer has torn the very fabric of the Shadowlands.[[Observational Records]] Before the [[Primus]] was taken by the Jailer, he had entrusted his sigil to Korthia.[[Secrets of the Vault]] ==Getting there== Players initially access Korthia via the [[Beastwarrens]] in the [[Maw]], southeast of [[Desmotaeron]]. They quickly unlock a [[Waystone to Oribos (Korthia)|Waystone to Oribos]], which activates its pair in the [[Ring of Transference]] in [[Oribos]], as well as an [[Animaflow Teleporter]] to [[Ve'nari's Refuge]]. ==Geography== ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:VZ-Korthia.jpg|thumb|Zone map]] {| class="darktable hlist" |- | *[[Chamber of Knowledge]] *[[Chamber of Wisdom (Korthia)|Chamber of Wisdom]] *[[Estuary of Awakening]] *[[Hope's Ascent]] *[[Keeper's Respite]] **[[Reliquary of Remembrance]] *[[Mauler's Outlook]] *[[Path of Understanding|The Path of Understanding]] *[[Sanctuary of Guidance]] *[[Scholar's Den]] **[[Caverns of Contemplation]] *[[Seeker's Quorum]] **[[Chamber of Tranquility]] *[[Vault of Secrets]] **[[Chamber of the Sigil]] *[[Windswept Aerie]] **[[Gromit Hollow]] |} File:VZ-Caverns of Contemplation.jpg|[[Caverns of Contemplation]] File:VZ-Chamber of the Sigil.jpg|[[Chamber of the Sigil]] File:VZ-Gromit Hollow.jpg|[[Gromit Hollow]] ===Adjacent regions=== *[[Maw]] ([[Beastwarrens]]), on foot to the northwest *[[Oribos]], via [[Waystone to Oribos (Korthia)|Waystone to Oribos]] in [[Keeper's Respite]] ==Quests== [[File:Keeper's Respite.jpg|thumb|[[Keeper's Respite]], the quest hub]] {{main|Chains of Domination campaign}} When compared to the Maw, Korthia is a traditional zone, with multiple quest chains and a daily quest hub. Players travel to Korthia alongside [[Ve'nari]] to unlock access to a new [[Waystone to Oribos (Korthia)|Waystone to Oribos]], allowing the covenant combatants to freely cross over to the zone and back. Later, they go on some exploration and recovery missions to locate the missing fatescribe and recover a Shadowlands relic. ==Wildlife== Three new types of wildlife have been found in Korthia, as well as two new types of [[devourer]]s: *[[Gromit]]s *[[Razorwing]]s *[[Shardhide]]s Drab Hopper.jpg|[[Gromit]] Slitherwing Matriarch.jpg|[[Razorwing]] Shardhide Growler (Seeker's Quorum).png|[[Shardhide]] Mindseize Controller.png|[[Devourer|Devourer controller]] Nimble Scavenger.png|[[Devourer|Devourer mauler]] ==Rares and treasures== A great number of daily-lootable rares and containers, and one-time lootable treasures are found in [[Korthia]] (as well as next door in the Maw...). ===Rares=== [[File:Towering Exterminator.jpg|thumb|[[Towering Exterminator]]]] Four rares in Korthia are on a rotation, and may or may not spawn each day: [[Consumption (Korthia)|Consumption]], [[Kroke the Tormented]], [[Reliwik the Defiant]], and [[Zelnithop]]. Not all rares in the table below are actually in Korthia - several are also in the [[Maw]]. {{:Conquering Korthia}} ===Treasures=== [[File:Displaced Relic.jpg|thumb|[[Displaced Relic]]]] There are ten one-time lootable treasures in Korthia and [[Desmotaeron]] of the Maw, all required for [[Treasures of Korthia]]. {{:Treasures of Korthia}} ===Relic Fragment lootables=== Players can repeatedly loot [[Relic Fragment]]-containing lootables once a day per spawn. Some lootable types (like [[Invasive Mawshroom]]s) have multiple spawn locations each day, so players will be able to loot more than one of some types. ==Reputations== Two reputation factions are based in Korthia: [[Death's Advance]], and the [[Archivists' Codex]]. The Death's Advance represents the combined might of the four covenants after coming through to Korthia. Reputation is gained by completing [[Chains of Domination campaign#Korthia dailies|three to five daily quests]] from a large set of rotating questgivers. {{Death's Advance}} The Archivists' Codex is comprised of Korthian attendants devoted to collecting and storing the many relics found in the Shadowlands over the eons.
